role: The dispense-behavior interface, carrying the static default provider that hands the stack back unchanged.
scope_reason: Never runs: dispensing is driven by redstone power and world.conf redstone = off (no block ever receives power), so BlockDispenser's dispense path is dead in the world both sides run; the dispenser window also has no native container yet (csrc/engine/survival.c:3169). The dispenser block and its tile entity do exist natively (csrc/engine/activate.c ID_DISPENSER, csrc/engine/tileentity.c TE_DISPENSER).
